programme.desc: תעודת זהות ישראלית-ישראל והתפוצות-חלק א. מה באמת מחבר את כולנו? מה סוד הקיום היהודי? ואיך נשמרה הערבות ההדדית בינינו לבין יהודי התפוצות במשך אלפי שנים? ערב מרגש ומעורר מחשבה על זהות, קשר ושייכות.כ' עב.

programme.title: מדינה קטנה
programme.desc: ליאור אשכנזי וצוות של היסטוריונים, דיפלומטים ומיניאטוריסטים יוצאים לבנות דגם מיניאטורי שישחזר את ביקור סאדאת בישראל ב-19.11.77, ועל הדרך לגלות מה באמת התרחש מאחורי הקלעים של הביקור ההיסטורי. כ' עב'.

programme.title: שום פלפל ושמן זית

programme.title: מה היא חושבת לעצמה

programme.title: קסם המזרח

programme.title: מתי אוכלים?

programme.desc: Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

programme.desc: Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Heute vom Supercross Cup in München. Mit den besten Fahrerern aus aller Welt, die angereist sind, um die Krone mit nach Hause zu nehmen – Wer wird König von München? programme.title: Grüne Welle
programme.desc: 1996 war er Vorreiter in Sachen Hybridantrieb: Der Toyota Prius. 2016 ist bereits die vierte Generation auf dem Markt. Was hat sich seitdem getan und wie zukunftsweisend ist der Prius? Auch der Antrieb mit Wasserstoff ist kein neues Phänomen. Doch es scheint immer noch kein Schwung in den Markt der Brennstoffzellenfahrzeuge zu kommen. Kann der Hyundai ix35 Fuel Cell das ändern? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: Der Name Rolls Royce steht seit jeher für Exklusivität, Luxus und britische Automobilbaukunst. Die legendären Fahrzeuge mit der Spirit of Ecstasy auf dem Kühlergrill entstehen seit Anfang des 20. Jahrhunderts in England. Heute sind es vor allem sehr betuchte Menschen, die die Entscheidung treffen, einen Rolls Royce zu erwerben. Dabei ist kein bestelltes Modell wie das Andere. Denn die Maßabteilung Bespoke lässt keinen Individualisierungswunsch unerfüllt und so ist jedes Fahrzeug ein absolutes Einzelstück. Made in blickt hinter die Kulissen des Rolls Royce Werks in Südengland. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Abenteuer Allrad
programme.desc: Ein Special Interest-Magazin rund um offroad-taugliche und allradgetriebene Fahrzeuge. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Gelände-Urgesteine und PKW mit Allradantrieb. Rustikal, kantig, und fast ganz der Alte. Der Nissan X-Trail. Äußerlich ist er erst auf den dritten Blick von seinem Vorgänger zu unterscheiden und das obwohl in diesem SUV eigentlich nichts beim Alten geblieben ist. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Die heutige Folge Perfect Ride wird von knallharten Jungs und heißen Stunts beherrscht. Wir schauen hinter die Kulissen von Action Concept, dem größten Actionfilmproduzenten Europas. Und: Der Stuck-Test auf dem Track. Diesmal mit keinem Geringeren, als dem Alpina D5 Biturbo! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Tuning – Tiefer geht's nicht!
programme.desc: Die Firma Mechatronik ist Spezialist für Mercedes Oldtimer. Seit 1997 widmet sich das Team der Restauration und Veredelung der Klassiker. Außerdem: Der Nissan 370 Z ist gehörige Konkurrenz für Posche Cayman & Co, zu einem unschlagbaren Preis. Und: Der Chevrolet Camaro ist ein echtes amerikanisches Muscle-Car. Jetzt gibt es den aktuellen Camaro endlich auch in Europa. Zudem: Das ist zweifellos der mächtigste Gegner von BMW X5M oder X6M. Der Mercedes ML 63 AMG. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.sub-title: Klassiker auf dem Weg zur Auktion
programme.desc: In dieser Folge von Top Speed besucht Moderator Martin Utberg die Oldtimer Galerie in Toffen in der Schweiz. Seit über vier Jahrzehnten ist sie eine feste Adresse für Liebhaber klassischer Automobile und bekannt für ihre regelmäßig stattfindenden Oldtimer-Auktionen. Gemeinsam mit Auktionator Serge Stotzer und seinem Team wirft Martin einen Blick hinter die Kulissen der Vorbereitungen für die nächste Versteigerung. Einige der Fahrzeuge, die am Samstag, dem 21. März, unter den Hammer kommen, werden dabei genauer vorgestellt – und Martin nimmt auch selbst hinter dem Steuer Platz, um diese Klassiker auf der Straße zu erleben. programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Die US-Marke Cadillac aus Detroit steht für den American Way of Drive und überschwänglichen Luxus made in USA. Das Cadillac Series 62 Cabrio von 1949 trägt als erstes US-Car die berühmten und oftmals zitierten Heckflossen. Ein bulliges V8-Triebwerk, Automatik-Getriebe und elektrisches Verdeck sind für einen Caddy dieser Ära selbstverständlich. Classic Ride lässt mit dem Heckflossen-Monster den American Way of Drive wieder auferleben. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: In der ersten Folge von 2021 blickt Top-Speed-Moderator Martin Utberg auf das vergangene Jahr 2020 zurück. Ein Jahr, in dem aufgrund der Corona-Pandemie kaum Oldtimer-Events stattfanden. Trotzdem gelang es den Top Speed-Redakteuren, die geplanten 26 Folgen mit interessanten Themen und Gästen zu füllen. Diese Folge enthält Bilder von: dem Classica Eismarathon, der Schwarzwald Winter Challenge, Retro Classics in Stuttgart, der Oldtimer Galerie Toffen und dem Mac Museum in Singen. Prominente Gäste wie Jochen Mass, Hans-Joachim "Strietzel" Stuck und Prinz Leopold von Bayern vervollständigen diese Folge. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Überschläge, Rampensprünge, Crashs – es gibt 1000 Wege Autos zu zerstören. Die Stunt Heroes kennen sie alle! Die Reportage blickt nochmal auf die Car-Highlights der letzten Monate zurück. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Slowenien – Motorradziele gibt es in Europa viele, aber kaum jemand denkt dabei an Slowenien. Auf unserer Tour durch Slowenien haben wir festgestellt, dass sich ein Besuch auf zwei Rädern definitiv lohnt. Verschiedene Landschaftsformen mit Hochgebirgszügen, Mittelgebirge und Hügel-land, sowie die slowenische Riviera haben Ihren Reiz. Auf unseren Touren besuchen wir den Bleder See, Ljubljana, den Osten Sloweniens, die Höhlen von Postojna und natürlich Piran, die slowenische Riviera. Die Highlights und spektakuläre Drohnenflüge sind im Film zu sehen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Heute vom Supercross Cup in München. Mit den besten Fahrerern aus aller Welt, die angereist sind, um die Krone mit nach Hause zu nehmen – Wer wird König von München? Jetzt wissen wir es noch nicht, aber in wenigen Minuten, sind wir ein bisschen schlauer – das Highlight der Indoor-Motorsport Szene dieser Saison. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: 1949 wurde auf einem 4 km langen Stadtrundkurs in Ingolstadt erstmals ein Donauringrennen gestartet. Bis zu 100.000 Zuschauer säumten in den Folgejahren den Straßenrand. Seit dem Donauring Revival 1999 findet das Rennen nun auf einem 1,6 km langen Teilstück der ehemaligen Strecke statt. Classic ist vor Ort. Und: Ein Blick hinter die Kulissen der Leder-Restauration bei Firma Kienle in Heimerdingen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grüne Welle
programme.desc: 1996 war er Vorreiter in Sachen Hybridantrieb: Der Toyota Prius. 2016 ist bereits die vierte Generation auf dem Markt. Was hat sich seitdem getan und wie zukunftsweisend ist der Prius? Auch der Antrieb mit Wasserstoff ist kein neues Phänomen. Doch es scheint immer noch kein Schwung in den Markt der Brennstoffzellenfahrzeuge zu kommen. Kann der Hyundai ix35 Fuel Cell das ändern? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: Der Name Rolls Royce steht seit jeher für Exklusivität, Luxus und britische Automobilbaukunst. Die legendären Fahrzeuge mit der Spirit of Ecstasy auf dem Kühlergrill entstehen seit Anfang des 20. Jahrhunderts in England. Heute sind es vor allem sehr betuchte Menschen, die die Entscheidung treffen, einen Rolls Royce zu erwerben. Dabei ist kein bestelltes Modell wie das Andere. Denn die Maßabteilung Bespoke lässt keinen Individualisierungswunsch unerfüllt und so ist jedes Fahrzeug ein absolutes Einzelstück. Made in blickt hinter die Kulissen des Rolls Royce Werks in Südengland. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Abenteuer Allrad
programme.desc: Ein Special Interest-Magazin rund um offroad-taugliche und allradgetriebene Fahrzeuge. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Gelände-Urgesteine und PKW mit Allradantrieb. Rustikal, kantig, und fast ganz der Alte. Der Nissan X-Trail. Äußerlich ist er erst auf den dritten Blick von seinem Vorgänger zu unterscheiden und das obwohl in diesem SUV eigentlich nichts beim Alten geblieben ist. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Die heutige Folge Perfect Ride wird von knallharten Jungs und heißen Stunts beherrscht. Wir schauen hinter die Kulissen von Action Concept, dem größten Actionfilmproduzenten Europas. Und: Der Stuck-Test auf dem Track. Diesmal mit keinem Geringeren, als dem Alpina D5 Biturbo! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Kombis sind praktische Lastenesel mit viel Platz, Familienkutschen oder beides. Doch Skoda Octavia Scout und Opal Insignia Country Tourer wollen mehr sein. Sie wecken durch ihre Offroad-Optik den Abenteurerinstinkt. Erhöhte Bodenfreiheit, Radblenden, Unterfahrschutz und Seitenbeplankung verleihen ihnen den Gelände-Look – ihr Allradantrieb sorgt für die richtige Traktion abseits befestigter Straßen. Es muss also nicht immer nur ein SUV sein. Cross-Kombis im Test. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Tuning – Tiefer geht's nicht!
programme.desc: Die Firma Mechatronik ist Spezialist für Mercedes Oldtimer. Seit 1997 widmet sich das Team der Restauration und Veredelung der Klassiker. Außerdem: Der Nissan 370 Z ist gehörige Konkurrenz für Posche Cayman & Co, zu einem unschlagbaren Preis. Und: Der Chevrolet Camaro ist ein echtes amerikanisches Muscle-Car. Jetzt gibt es den aktuellen Camaro endlich auch in Europa. Zudem: Das ist zweifellos der mächtigste Gegner von BMW X5M oder X6M. Der Mercedes ML 63 AMG. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.sub-title: Klassiker auf dem Weg zur Auktion
programme.desc: In dieser Folge von Top Speed besucht Moderator Martin Utberg die Oldtimer Galerie in Toffen in der Schweiz. Seit über vier Jahrzehnten ist sie eine feste Adresse für Liebhaber klassischer Automobile und bekannt für ihre regelmäßig stattfindenden Oldtimer-Auktionen. Gemeinsam mit Auktionator Serge Stotzer und seinem Team wirft Martin einen Blick hinter die Kulissen der Vorbereitungen für die nächste Versteigerung. Einige der Fahrzeuge, die am Samstag, dem 21. März, unter den Hammer kommen, werden dabei genauer vorgestellt – und Martin nimmt auch selbst hinter dem Steuer Platz, um diese Klassiker auf der Straße zu erleben. programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Ferrari hat wie kaum ein zweiter Hersteller seine Wurzeln im Rennsport und fast jeder der seit 1947 produzierten Rennsportwagen hat in irgendeiner Form bis heute überlebt. Um dieses rasende Museum gebührend in Szene zu setzen gründete man 1995 die Historic Challenge – ein Markenpokal für historische Rennwagen. Classic stellt die Rennserie vor. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grüne Welle
programme.desc: Die Automobil-Branche wandelt sich gerade komplett: Fahrzeuge entwickeln sich zu autonom fahrenden, voll vernetzten Digital-Devices. Die Verkehrssicherheit soll sich stark verbessern. Aber wie funktionieren Assistenz-Systeme eigentlich? Und wie sicher sind selbstfahrende PKW? MOTORVISION schaut Ingenieuren von Daimler über die Schulter – kurz vor dem Launch der neuen S-Klasse im Herbst 2017. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: Die Geschichte der Feuerwehr reicht bis in die Römerzeit zurück. Damals mussten sich vornehmlich Sklaven der brennenden Gefahr aussetzen. Im Mittelalter sorgten die Zünfte für die Brandbekämpfung aber erst mit einem Mann wurde in Deutschland die Feuerwehr nachhaltig strukturiert: Conrad Dietrich Magirus. Er gilt als der Pionier in der Feuerwehrtechnik. In seiner Heimatstadt Ulm werden bis heute die modernsten Feuerwehrfahrzeuge zu 100 Prozent von Hand gebaut. MOTORVISION TV blickt hinter die Kulissen des Unternehmens mit über 150-jähriger Geschichte und zeigt die Fertigung von Drehleiter- und Löschfahrzeugen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Abenteuer Allrad
programme.desc: Abenteuer Allrad, ein Special Interest-Magazin rund um offroad-taugliche und allradgetriebene Fahrzeuge. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Gelände-Urgesteine und PKW mit Allradantrieb. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: Out of Space – Gefährte jenseits von Normal
programme.desc: In dieser Folge Perfect Ride zeigen wir euch Autos Out of Space – Gefährte, die jenseits von Normal sind. Der Fahrradi Farfalla gehört wohl zu den ungewöhnlichsten Autos der Welt. Wir haben seinen Erbauer Hannes Langeder in Österreich besucht. Und: Auf der Essen Motor Show stehen jeden Menge abgefahrene Unikate. Die Extremsten davon haben wir uns mal genauer angesehen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Er ist fast 4 Meter hoch und seine Reifen haben einen Durchmesser von 1,50 Meter. Dieser Monstertruck ist ein Fiat Panda! Der Bigfoot-Panda und andere extreme Offroader. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Tuning – Tiefer geht's nicht!
programme.desc: Der MF5 GT. Das Kraftpaket aus dem Hause Wiesmann. Porschejäger mit BMW M-Power. Er ist der schnellste Gecko, der je auf der Straße gesichtet wurde! Außerdem: In Bottrop entstehen Männerträume. Wer Exklusivität sucht und selbst die Leistung eines Mercedes AMG als zu gering empfindet, ist hier genau richtig: Die Firma Brabus ist einer der bekanntesten Tuner der Welt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Top Speed-Moderator Martin Utberg wurde von Porsche-Enthusiast Ralf Gerhard ins Saarland eingeladen, um gemeinsam mit ihm ein Abendessen für eine kleine Gruppe von Personen zuzubereiten. Das Restaurant, das Ralf ausgewählt hat, war bereits in einer früheren Folge von Top Speed zu sehen. Dort fand das Oldtimer-Event Klassik Atos im Grünen statt. Außerdem hat Ralf einen Besuch bei einem Porsche-356-Spezialisten geplant, und Martin trifft Mitglieder des Porsche 356 Club Deutschland. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Und der Mythos Lamborghini beginnt beim Namen. Chronik des Stierkampfes 1879. In der Arena von Cordoba widersteht ein Stier den Torreros und überlebt trotz 24 Stichen. Sein Name: Murcielago (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: Steigerung der Perfektion? Gibt es eigentlich nicht. Oder doch? In welche Kategorie fallen Fahrzeuge, die das Vorstellungsvermögen an Exklusivität und Performance übersteigen? Di e den Geldbeutel der meisten Menschen sprengen? Supercars zeigt Traumautos in traumhafter Umgebung, diesmal unter anderem den Bugatti Veyron Supersport! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: NTT Indycar Series 2026
programme.sub-title: Honda Indy 200 at Mid Ohio, Mid-Ohio Sports Cars Course, Ohio
programme.desc: Amerikas führende Open-Wheel-Serie. Ovale, Straßenkurse, Rundkurse und das legendäre Indianapolis 500 pure Rennsport-Leidenschaft in der NTT IndyCar Series. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: FIM Superenduro World Championship 2024
programme.desc: Superenduro ist eine Indoor-Motorradmeisterschaft, bei der Fahrer ihre Konkurrenz in Sprintrennen schlagen müssen, während sie über Hindernisse auf der Strecke fahren (Senderinfo).

programme.title: FIM Sidecarcross World Championship 2026
programme.sub-title: GP of United Kingdom, Canada Heights

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World and European Championship 2026
programme.sub-title: GP GP Czech Republic, Vysoke Mito

programme.title: FIM Enduro World Championship 2026
programme.desc: In der Sendung werden besten Enduro-Piloten der Welt bei ihren Wettkämpfen rund um den Erdball begleitet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2025
programme.desc: Die X-Trial World Championship ist eine Indoor-Motorradserie, bei der Fahrer Hindernisse auf der Strecke bewältigen müssen (Senderinfo).

programme.title: IndyNXT 2026
programme.desc: Die Nachwuchsserie der IndyCar: Junge Talente kämpfen auf Ovalen und Rundkursen um den Aufstieg. Schnell, hart und der direkte Weg in die NTT IndyCar Series. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Going Pro 2026
programme.desc: Die siebte Staffel der Going Pro TV-Serie begleitet Damon Surzyshyn und die gesamte PROsport Racing-Mannschaft in der ADAC GT4 Germany-Saison 2026 (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fastzone 2026
programme.desc: Die Sendung nimmt das Publikum mit in die faszinierende Welt des internationalen Rennsports. Das Format verbindet packende Motorsport‑Action mit fundierten Analysen und liefert einen umfassenden Überblick über bedeutende Rennserien rund um den Globus. Neben spektakulären Szenen auf der Strecke bietet das Format spannende Hintergrundberichte, technische Einblicke und Geschichten über Fahrer, Teams und ihre Herausforderungen. So entsteht ein vielseitiger Blick auf Geschwindigkeit, Wettbewerb und die Leidenschaft, die den Motorsport weltweit antreibt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: SUVs verkaufen sich wie warme Semmeln. Über 50 % Marktanteil in Europa 2024 ein Rekordwert! Besonders beliebt sind Kompakt-SUV und der Dacia Bigster mischt das Segment ordentlich auf. Rund 10.000 Euro günstiger als die Konkurrenz ist eine Kampfansage. Aber ist er wirklich gut oder nur billig und nix dahinter? Außerdem: Fünf spannende Facts zur brandneuen dritten Generation des Audi Q3. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: Er ist die Vision einer elektrischen Zukunft von AMG: Der Concept AMG GT XX leistet unfassbare 1360 PS und lädt schneller als man Reichweitenangst sagen kann. Wir waren bei der spektakulären Weltpremiere dabei. Und: Dieser Renner sieht aus wie aus einem Retro-Film entsprungen ist aber das brandneue Topmodell von Morgan. Wir verraten fünf spannende Fakten zu diesem britischen Kunstwerk. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grüne Welle
programme.desc: Wie transportieren wir Güter und Personen in Zukunft? Auch die Lastenesel unserer Straßen entwickeln sich weiter und gehen mit der Zeit. VW arbeitet mit Ford zusammen, um beim neuen Transporter Kosten zu sparen und Kompetenzen zu bündeln. Bei Volvo steht schon immer die Sicherheit im Vordergrund – und das gilt auch für die LKW. Und 5 spannende Fakten zum Mercedes eCitaro NMC4. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Crashen oder gecrasht werden, dass ist beim Stockcar Rennen in Herzfelde die große Frage! Um seine Konkurrenten aus dem Rennen zu katapultieren, bedarf es wenig. Man nehme ein schrottreifes Fahrzeug, entferne Glasscheiben, Kleinteile, Rücksitzbank und Beifahrersitz. Airbags sind unerwünscht. Sturzhelm, Sicherheitsgurt und Überrollbügel reichen hier vollkommen aus. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MotorStories
programme.desc: Welches ist das amerikanische Auto der 60er? Das Sinnbild amerikanischer Autobaukunst dieser Zeit? Keine Frage, die meisten US-Car Fans würden antworten: Chevrolet Corvette oder der Ford Mustang. Auf der Suche nach diesen amerikanischen Traumautos macht Tillmann Miritz bei seiner Reise durch Florida eine überraschende Entdeckung. Bei REVOLOGY CARS in Orlando werden originale 1964er Ford Mustang Karossen in Handarbeit mit modernster Technik und Motoren ausgestattet und Tillmann darf mit einer dieser wunderbaren Replikas eine Probefahrt unternehmen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: IndyNXT 2026
programme.desc: Die Nachwuchsserie der IndyCar: Junge Talente kämpfen auf Ovalen und Rundkursen um den Aufstieg. Schnell, hart und der direkte Weg in die NTT IndyCar Series. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Die deutsche Quad- und ATV-Gemeinde bläst traditionell zur Jagd auf den Yeti! Im thüringischen Suhl werden wieder weit über 200 Quad- und ATV-Piloten an den Start gehen, um mitten im Winter einen Tag lang ihrer Offroad-Leidenschaft nachzugehen. Und Thorunn nicht nur mitten drin, sondern fährt mit bei dieser außergewöhnlichen Winteraction. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa
programme.desc: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent - Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the park's establishment gave rhinos a lifeline - breeding them back from extinction.

programme.title: Turtle Beach
programme.desc: Locals call it the 'arribada', or 'arrival'. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

programme.title: Wild Latin America
programme.desc: Get to know South America's only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators - before it's too late.

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix's search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo
programme.desc: The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of food.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo
programme.desc: Eastern Grey kangaroos are prolific breeders, but bringing up baby is fraught with challenges. Predators, climate extremes, and lively joeys mean kangaroo mothers face a daily struggle to keep their young alive.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo
programme.desc: Follow several different males as they roam the land, climb up the social ladder, and fight for their mating rights in Eastern Grey colony. For these bucks, the drive to perpetuate their species promises a life full of risk and reward.

programme.title: Macaque Island
programme.desc: Explore the lush treed cityscape where fluffy male Matnoor rules over the 30-member-strong Street Troop with an iron fist. Then meet Aarav, the old alpha who oversees the wilder Hill Troop. Which will up-and-comer Loci challenge for the crown?

programme.title: Macaque Island
programme.desc: Go on a junk-food-fuelled urban holiday with the Street Troop, then watch the Hill Troop's invasion of their turf turn sour. Monitor the Sisterhood's plot to kidnap Sara's baby before newly minted alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back in town.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africa's amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic.

programme.title: Baby Animals
programme.desc: Follow the staff at Parc Omega in Quebec, Canada, during the busy spring when moose, boars, raccoons, and visiting Canada geese have their babies.

programme.title: Animals at Play
programme.desc: Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists' cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweed-all following specific rules that hone social bonds.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: South Africa's Drakensberg is one of the continent's most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned Walia ibex.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the secrets to their survival. From the largest mammals to the fastest insects and even a ghost-like fish found nowhere else in the world, the Southern Drylands contain some extraordinary inhabitants, all connected by the daily challenges of living in some of most inhospitable habitats in the world.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser flamingos.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Follow the course of South Africa's Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the beauty of Augrabies; this is the story of the Linear Oasis. We reveal how life is adapted to survive along its course and discover a rich world of plants and animals.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia
programme.desc: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss, and gain friends, as they discover what it means to be part of the Woodland Troop.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia
programme.desc: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia
programme.desc: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

programme.title: Tales from Zambia
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place offers something unique to the wildlife that chooses to live there.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in nature's great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa.

programme.title: Superbeast
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom's most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth's fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the world's 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are nature's best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: A Bee's Diary
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee's Diary tells that story.

Check out her dessert wine poached Grilled Pears and Blue Cheese Salad. Next, Beef Tartare Sliders are spiked with horseradish aioli and served on warm brioche. Pasta follows, but in keeping with her topsy turvy theme, Korean flavour meets Italian savour in her Kimchi Pappardelle. Fish is next, Loup de Mer en Papillote with Ã‰crasé Potatoes is dressed up with shaved fennel and rich beurre rouge sauce. How do you end an inside-outside- upside-downside dinner? With the perfect starter! Check out Kim's Oyster Shooters with Champagne Granité for a perfect final note...

programme.title: One Big Recipe
programme.desc: What on earth and/or sea is super fun host Kim Lallouz cooking this week for her One Big Recipe? You guessed it - Surf and Turf! First on the beach are her Singapore-inspired Chili Crab Cakes, redolent with southeast Asian aromatics and spices like lemongrass, ginger, and galangal. 'Turf's up' next with a fresh off-the-hoof Marrow Toast plate decked out with melty marrow, crispy crostini, and garlicky parsley salad. We all deserve a creamy cheesy break (right?), so of course Risotto Carbonara with Crispy Pancetta and Enoki Mushrooms follows. Braised Veal Osso Bucco is the big deal main course, all shored up surfingly with scrumptious Seared Scallops and smoky Grilled Broccoli Rabe!

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc:
Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.

The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.

Fish is next, Loup de Mer en Papillote with Ã‰crasé Potatoes is dressed up with shaved fennel and rich beurre rouge sauce. How do you end an inside-outside- upside-downside dinner? programme.title: One Big Recipe
programme.desc: What on earth and/or sea is super fun host Kim Lallouz cooking this week for her One Big Recipe? You guessed it - Surf and Turf! First on the beach are her Singapore-inspired Chili Crab Cakes, redolent with southeast Asian aromatics and spices like lemongrass, ginger, and galangal. 'Turf's up' next with a fresh off-the-hoof Marrow Toast plate decked out with melty marrow, crispy crostini, and garlicky parsley salad. We all deserve a creamy cheesy break (right?), so of course Risotto Carbonara with Crispy Pancetta and Enoki Mushrooms follows. programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat the World
programme.desc: The boys land a massive sailfish in Puerto Escondido, learn to make blue corn tortillas in Chiapas, and cook a VIP meal for the Australian Ambassador.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat the World
programme.desc: In Spain, Andy and Ben explore La Boqueria Market, ride a gourmet food bus, hunt for wild mushrooms, and visit a farmhouse to cure sausages.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat the World
programme.desc: The boys try ancient Basque rock lifting, stomp wine grapes with their feet, taste local delicacies, and learn the fine art of carving jamón.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong heads to rugged Port Lincoln, SA to unlock local seafood secrets. He learns to trawl for wild prawns, harvest oysters and forage for unique coastal ingredients.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.desc: Lee discovers Germany, a nation known for its breathtaking countryside and hearty cuisine.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.desc: From the Great Wall to the Forbidden City, Lee tours China like never before. The streets of Beijing serve up a mix of modern architecture and ancient traditions, but nothing is more popular in Chinese cuisine than dumplings!

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.desc: Journeying through the Rocky Mountains to Vancouver, Lee celebrates Canada Day by preparing three iconic national dishes.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.desc: Embracing vibrant local fashions and spices, Lee tackles a complex 20-ingredient curry and uncovers the roots of tandoori chicken.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.sub-title: Philippines: Why is Filipino food unpopular?
programme.desc: Liesel embarks on a journey to the country of over 7000 islands, the Philippines. From the serene to the seedy, she combs through metro Manila discovering the food.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.sub-title: Thailand: US Thai Food vs Authentic-Thai, which is the winner?
programme.desc: Americans are accustomed to Thai food but what you get in mainland Thailand is quite different than the local Thai joint in California. Liesel embarks on a mission in Bangkok to understand the essence of what true Thai food is all about.

programme.title: Foodie Adventures with Ash Pollard
programme.desc: In Venice and San Daniele, Ash uncovers authentic prosciutto before returning home to cook an Italian feast for Joel Creasey.

programme.title: Capturing Winter
programme.desc: Self-taught adventure photographer Layla Kerley and Blackcrows co-founder Bruno Compagnet tackle a traverse of the Italian Dolomites, one of Europe's last true wildernesses.

programme.title: Capturing Winter
programme.desc: Photographer Tristan Shu chases his dream project: snapping ski and snowboard tricks at night against the Milky Way and Mont Blanc. It's astrophotography meets action sports in one ripper shot.

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: Escaping the hustle and bustle of the big city, James takes the train to visit the rest of England—proving the rest of England is more accessible than one might think.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond
programme.desc: Bboy Junior is going back to his roots in the country where he was born, The Democratic Republic of Congo. It is a country that is made up of over 100 different ethnic groups, making it the most diverse African nation. And in the last ten or fifteen years even Western culture, hip-hop and Breaking in particular, has found its way to Congo. Junior will be joined by world champion Shigekix, traveling all the way from Japan and visiting Africa for the first time. Together they will explore the dance, break and hip-hop culture in the city of Goma.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond
programme.desc: Russian Bgirl Kastet is visiting Sao Paulo, the home of Bboy Neguin. Together they will explore the dance, breaking and hip hop culture in the streets of Sao Paulo. Meeting up with legends and learning Capoeira, Jiu Jitsu and Passinho.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled
programme.desc: In the month of Movember Jonathan begins his first Balkan adventure. Growing a mustache for charity and exploring the concept of what it means to be a man. He begins in Albania, where strange bomb shelters dot the land. Was there a panic tantamount to America’s Cuban Missile Crisis? There he meets his first manly men.. rally race car drivers who take him on their beasty machines through gnarly back roads.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg enters Europe's poorest country where he goes dog catching, swings trapeze in an old Soviet circus, acquires a classic Dacia car, races horse drawn carts with the Gypsies, and cycles through one of the largest wine cellars.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled
programme.desc: Jonathan caps off the season with an expedition into the spirit of isolation; a journey that takes him from Arunchal pradesh, India, to Dolomites in Italy, to all the way down in Antarctica.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled
programme.desc: All the highs and lows of our beast of a third season; recounted by Jonathan as he shows the audience deleted scenes and gives them insider information on how the episodes came together.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to British Columbia’s beautiful Sunshine Coast, to explore the 112-mile long Sunshine Coast Trail and to test his nerves at the Coast Gravity Downhill Mountain Bike Park.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to the Peak District in England, to tackle the 268-mile Pennine Way—Britain’s oldest and most challenging National Trail.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads deep into the backcountry to explore the mountains, glaciers and wildlife around Alaska’s capital city of Juneau.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads 63 degrees north to Jämtland, Sweden, where he discovers a wild culture and breathtaking wilderness trails.

programme.title: Access All Areas
programme.desc: Adventurer Francesca Chiorando jets into Belfast—which was once one of Europe’s most volatile cities—to track down ex-terrorists.

programme.title: Access All Areas
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando travels to Sunny Beach, Bulgaria to find out if this is a Holiday heaven or Holiday hell.

programme.title: Epic Exploring
programme.desc: Cody goes off the beaten path in Thessaloniki, Greece. He runs over wagons at a train cemetery, explores a factory with drones, and dives to a shipwreck.

programme.title: Epic Exploring
programme.desc: While exploring in the industrial Ruhr District in Germany, Josh discovers abandoned steel and mining factories and experiences a miner’s life underneath the ground.

programme.title: Epic Exploring
programme.desc: Cody experiences \.

programme.title: Epic Exploring
programme.desc: Local exploring in industrial Charleroi brings Cody to abandoned factories and an unknown spot full of colorful graffiti. An old casino awaits to be explored.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali
programme.desc: In Bali's lush landscapes, Lauren explores the tropical origin of jackfruit, partnering with a Balinese chef to unveil age-old recipes and techniques, showcasing how this versatile fruit reigns supreme in traditional and modern dishes.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali
programme.desc: Lauren dives into the world of rice, exploring varieties and sharing tricks. She blends local and Western flavours in dishes like Balinese nasi goreng and risotto.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali
programme.desc: Journey alongside Lauren as she delves into the vibrant world of turmeric. From infusing it into dishes like Urap Pakis to crafting a healthful elixir called Jamu, discover the captivating flavors against the breathtaking backdrop of Mount Agung.

programme.desc: Frikkie tries his hand at some dental treatment: in a lion's mouth, with a stick – and without anesthetics.

programme.desc: Young lioness Martha and her four brothers discover their hunting instinct: they kill a warthog.

programme.title: Harnas Wildlife Rescue Camp
programme.desc: Farmers tell the team at Harnas that wild dogs have been stalking and killing their cows.

programme.title: Harnas Wildlife Rescue Camp
programme.desc: An orphaned wild dog is to be integrated into a pack, a wayward leopard is moved into a new enclosure, while some members of the team are looking for insects to provide food for the bat-eared dogs.

programme.title: Man's First Friend

programme.title: Ostrich: A Life On The Run
programme.desc: This bird is something special: it can neither sing nor fly – but it is able to run at a speed of 70 km/h.

programme.title: Patrick and the Whale

programme.title: The Sanctuary - Survival Stories of the Alps

programme.title: Reasons to Love

programme.title: The Secret of Migrating Birds - Tryst at the Red Sea
programme.desc: Each spring, millions of migrating birds traverse Israel, connecting Africa, Asia, and Europe.

programme.title: Nature's Greatest Talents

programme.title: Nature's Greatest Talents
programme.desc: Navigation without a map? No problem. Building a fortress out of living bodies? Check.

programme.title: Nature's Networks

programme.title: Life At The Limits

programme.title: Amazing Pigs

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.
